senders.what: `transport_player_to`. Requests: `transport`, `enter`, `leave`, `respawn`, `join`, `duel`. Timers: the end of `town`, `magiport` and `blink`. Penalties: jail (`gm`, a `move` line violation), the red zone of `move`. Server loops: event sign-ups, the end of an instance, cave doors, bank entry and exit
`transport_observer_to`: the `o:home` handler, the broadcast camera, the observer loop (every 13.2 s) and the end of an instance
